description: Mounted outdoors at the entrance to the former Naval Weapons Industrial Reserve Plant Calverton where every F-14 was flight-tested; BuNo checks against the F-14A block 160887-160930; wears 134; the airframe has weathered badly and press coverage has repeatedly called for restoration
